name: hcps-html-report-widget
label: HCPS HTML Reports
author: OpenAI / Ravneet Kathuria
description: Generates modern HCPS-branded HTML, CSV, and browser print-to-PDF reports from selected web map features, or current map extent features when nothing is selected using templates extracted from ArcGIS Pro .rptx reports. Preserves the original .rptx detail-band layout, starts detail pages cleanly for PDF, defaults to current-map-extent querying when no layer records are selected, includes full visible-viewport map preview screenshots and extent-first default querying, and supports manual template-to-layer mapping.
